claim: The show is about kicking ass as men from the inside out, to create the life and relationships we desire and uncover our most powerful version
What sets this movement apart is the focus on the power of our sexuality
Our sexuality impacts every aspect of life, so we absolutely need to dial it in, through the lens of empowered, sacred, healed sexuality
NoFap is technically a community, a forum
NoFap, in its own description: "NoFap is a community-based peer support website to help people overcome porn addiction and other forms of compulsive sexual behavior"
What a lot of guys understand by NoFap: stopping the porn-masturbation-ejaculation habit
Stopping the porn-masturbation-ejaculation habit, what a lot of guys understand by NoFap, is a very worthy goal, but very incomplete

Imagine being asked before coming to Earth, depending on what you believe, what you want out of your life as a sexual being. Would you say "I want to stop my compulsive sexual behavior"? "I doubt it. I very much doubt it"
Stopping porn and compulsive behavior is only a very small part of healing our sexuality and getting everything out of it

In the long-term journey of healing our sexuality, getting past porn is "actually like step two out of 26" (a foreign concept to some, clear to those further along): not an easy step, and it needs to happen, but a very small part of the process
The Holistic Alpha way approaches sexuality knowing that, for better or worse, it will have a big impact on our life
The Holistic Alpha way: not only heal the negative aspects of sexuality and get rid of porn and compulsive behavior, but work on all the positive aspects

The positive aspects of sexuality to work on, the Holistic Alpha way: turn sexuality and sexual practices into physical energy and confidence, improved sexual experiences with partners, and sexual energy transmuted into creativity, life force and confidence

Working on the positive aspects of sexuality opens a whole world of positive impacts, as an individual and in a relationship: expanding sexuality, improving our access to it and harnessing it into life, new versions of ourselves, things we create, people we attract and relationships we build
Four tools are indispensable, in this view, for overcoming porn for good, and also help in the entire process of the Holistic Alpha way
Purpose, a real reason why, is one of four tools, in this view indispensable, for overcoming porn for good
Guys don't really care about stopping porn itself
A reason why to overcome porn, maybe: it's affecting your erections with your girlfriend or wife
A reason why to overcome porn, maybe: you feel the energetic drain and know you won't be disciplined enough to create the life you want
A reason why to overcome porn, maybe: you want to reconnect with your soul after the disconnection and inner-world effect of porn
A reason why to overcome porn may be a combination of reasons, or something completely different
A reason to overcome porn of only "porn sucks", it drags me down, is okay, but not really enough: not doing something is not sufficient motivation for the vast majority of human beings
To overcome porn, we need a target
Encouraged: don't leave your reason why for overcoming porn general and vague
For your why, play out the two scenarios, what positive things will or won't happen depending on whether you get past porn, and the positive scenario of what you really want is your why
Meditation, said a lot on the show for a very good reason, is one of four tools, in this view indispensable, for overcoming porn for good

Overcoming porn, and actually the vast majority of this sexual health stuff, has some physical aspects, practices and techniques, but a big part of the journey of our sexual health, and certainly overcoming porn, is an inner world game
In overcoming porn, your mind and emotions drive it one way or the other, and you'll need a new and improved handle on them
"there is no more fundamental way to get a better handle on what is happening in our mind and our emotions than meditation, period": the fundamental inner-world self-care practice
Biking or walking may be meditative, and that's great, but a sitting-still meditation, just with your inner world, has certain value
Bigger picture, in overcoming porn, meditation helps you understand what is going on in your inner world, including some of your triggers and how to work through them
Bigger picture, meditation helps you become more of an observer instead of getting caught up
In the moment of the urge toward the compulsive behavior you no longer want, your ability to choose a new path depends on how you approach that brief window of opportunity in your inner world
Meditation is the foundational way to upgrade how you respond in the brief window of opportunity of an urge toward the compulsive behavior you no longer want

The vast majority of things affecting our mental, physical, emotional and sexual health (porn, working out, a conversation with your wife, how you eat) are driven by very brief windows of opportunity, and moving through them well depends on your connection with your inner world
If you're not meditating, please start
A great way to start meditating is the Headspace app: look for Headspace basics
Insight Timer is another way to meditate; there are a ton of ways, so find one that works for you
If meditation didn't really stick before, or you haven't ever really tried, Headspace is very much recommended; if you have another way, go for it
Cold exposure, one of four tools, in this view indispensable, for overcoming porn for good: a cold shower, a cold plunge, even time outside, like a walk or hike
Some of what cold exposure does in body and mind is very directly linked with getting past porn
As you may know from the NoFap community or forums, porn messes up your dopamine system in major ways
After porn, we need to heal the dopamine system toward a more stable, reliable supply and response, without giant artificial spikes and giant crashes ("a very simplistic way to describe it")
As little as 11 minutes of cold exposure per week, not per day, "has shown significant benefits" in dopamine levels and response
Boosting dopamine is one of the body's immediate responses to cold, in a very natural, healthy way, raised for hours afterward
Dopamine is absolutely not a bad thing
You might associate dopamine with pleasure, but it is known as the motivation molecule
With dopamine, what matters is where we get it from and how stable our levels are
On the porn-masturbation-ejaculation cycle you get a massive dopamine spike, then crash, and basically run most of your life on super low levels
We want healthy, steady dopamine levels all the time, which help us be motivated, disciplined, feel good and get shit done
With cold exposure, norepinephrine and epinephrine go up, basically adrenaline, what gives you energy
The instinct to freak out, move, maybe yell in the cold is norepinephrine and epinephrine at work
Like dopamine, the norepinephrine and epinephrine raised by cold exposure stay raised for hours
With more mental energy through your day from cold exposure, in moments of urges, workout and food choices, you make better choices and get better outcomes
You'll have to do tough shit to create the life you want, "Period"
Overcoming porn will be hard, with hard moments to push through; so will the body, business and relationships you want
Stop hoping for overcoming porn, or the body, business and relationships you want, not to be hard, and get better at doing hard things
Cold exposure builds grit and toughness, very directly linked with getting past porn: regular cold exposure is regular practice in doing hard things
Other benefits of cold exposure, not directly about porn: it boosts your immune system and reduces inflammation, among various others
Personally, so many guys, coaching clients and guys from training programs, have said over and over that the cold shower became a staple once they started
The cold shower is also probably the most effective emotional reset personally, "or at least one of them": very powerful when you're feeling down, stressed, depressed or lethargic
Cold exposure dose: in essence, about 11 minutes per week is a sweet spot, about a minute and a half per day or so
No need to push cold exposure significantly beyond the sweet spot of about 11 minutes per week or set records
If the water is not as cold (Florida cold showers are not comparatively all that cold), you may want to push up a little, a three-, four- or five-minute cold shower
In very, very cold water you can be on the shorter end of the cold exposure dose
Now that it's winter in a lot of places, a walk or hike in minimal clothes works too for cold exposure
Walks and jogs in the Utah winter in just shorts, no shirt and barefoot (barefoot running)

Cold exposure in the air takes longer, because water pulls heat out of your body much faster than air: two, three or five minutes outside is refreshing but doesn't do what the same time in cold water does
A plan is one of four tools, in this view indispensable, for overcoming porn for good
For overcoming porn, if your only plan is what you're not going to do, "you're screwed"

A plan of only what you're not going to do is like being on the coast of California, with the entire rest of the United States to your east, and answering where you're going with "not going into the ocean": it tells you nothing
If your only plan is to stop masturbating and looking at porn, it won't get you where you want to go, "I promise"
To overcome porn, you need an actual plan of where to go

The aim of this work is not only to move past the compulsive, unwanted stuff that drags you down but, as or more importantly, to move deeply into the positive end, where sexuality becomes deeply and powerfully empowering: lifting you up, brightening your energy, improving your relationships, creativity, discipline and ability to create
Still on the journey, with no end point, always learning and growing, yet sexuality in his life now versus several years ago, and certainly 10 or 15 years ago, is "light years different"
In a community, surrounded by other guys working on getting past porn and empowering their sexuality, with similar priorities and experiences, you make progress way faster
name: Community and accountability
